title: Restaurant kit (template) — tables and events, not unread chats

hero.headline: From interest to a reserved table or event enquiry.
hero.copy: Friday night WhatsApp for a table of six gets lost in the kitchen group. This kit takes covers, time, and occasion, then confirms by the house rules.

messages.text: Saturday 8pm — indoor or terrace? Any birthday or cake note?
Request saved. The host will confirm the table and cake options.
Large groups follow house confirmation rules.

problem.title: The dining room is full. The inbox is not a host.
copy: Guests message while the floor is slammed.
Event enquiries die because nobody copied them into a sheet.

fixes.title: Review after a good night
fixes.copy: Ask when the visit is complete.

cards.title: Reservation request
cards.copy: House rules: auto-confirm small parties or always host-confirm.

cards.title: Party enquiry
cards.copy: Route to the events manager with context.

cards.title: Feedback + review
cards.copy: Private complaint to a human. Public review ask after a good visit.

workflow.title: Maps and Instagram into one host thread.
workflow.copy: The floor should not reconstruct the chat from memory.

stop: Promising a table that is not the host’s to give

faq.a: No. Large parties go to a human.
It can note a request. It does not give medical advice.

form.title: Build a restaurant demo from this kit.
form.copy: Covers, peak nights, and the leak.

whatsapp.demoText: Hi Webwise, I want a restaurant kit demo.

resultCard.leakLabel: Missed Saturday tables / small events. Range only.
resultCard.story: A table of six that never got a reply is a night of revenue, not a social-media problem.

leakQuiz.q: How fast do you reply after hours?

rules.systemPrompt: Restaurant host assistant. Capture covers, time, occasion. Large groups and complaints to a human. No medical allergy advice.

approved.response: Ask time, indoor/terrace, occasion. Save for host confirmation if required.
